info.name: Britive Services API Documentation My Devices API
Get all device profiles associated with the user with an API token

params.name: page
params.description: page number of profile list. Default is 0

params.name: size
params.description: size of the request for profile list. Default is 20.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filters for device profiles that can be applied - appName, papName, deviceName, platformName, accountName, deviceId, appType. Operators - eq, sw, co

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorting of device profiles that can be applied - appName, papName, deviceName, platformName, accountName, deviceId, appType. Operators - asc, desc

items.docs: Get all device profiles associated with the user with an API token

info.name: Check in profile for a device

params.name: transactionId
params.description: Transaction ID returned by the checkout call

items.docs: Check in a previously checked-out profile session. The `transactionId` is returned by the checkout call. Terminates the active session and revokes any issued credentials.

params.name: accessType
params.description: Type of access to checkout. `DEVICE` elevates privileges of the device. This is the only supported type.

items.docs: Checkout a profile for a specific device. Use `accessType=DEVICE` to elevate privileges on the device.
